title: Viva Insights: GitHub Copilot spend and usage page in the Consumption Dashboard
summary: Hold: the briefing says no admin interface is documented for switching the Viva Insights web app off, although Microsoft documents that control and its policy interface. It also promises managers GitHub insights without an extra step despite Learn requiring the GitHub preview to be enabled.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an admin UI for enabling or disabling the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: The AI admin can turn the Viva Insights web app on or off at the tenant, group, or user level using the Viva Insights web app feature access management control in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.fix: Populate controls[4].ui with surface 'Microsoft 365 admin center', path 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting', and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/control-access-admin-center. Add to its note: 'Select the Viva Insights app and Viva Insights web app feature; choose On or Off, then Everyone or Specific people and groups.' The feature-specific control is confirmed at https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/admin/manage-settings-copilot-dashboard#enable-or-disable-the-viva-insights-web-app.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide disabling policy.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Reflection -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone
claims.fix: Keep the call unchanged and add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/add-vivamodulefeaturepolicy to sources for its syntax and parameters. The currently cited settings page supplies the Viva Insights web app FeatureId and disabling-policy values.
